title: Agent Planning Benchmark: A Diagnostic Framework for Planning Capabilities in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2606.04874v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Planning is central to LLM agents: before acting, an agent must decompose goals, select tools, reason over constraints, and decide when a task is infeasible. Yet existing agent evaluations often report only end-to-end success, making it difficult to determine whether failures stem from planning or execution. We introduce Agent Planning Benchmark (APB), a planning-specific diagnostic benchmark with 4,209 multimodal cases across 22 domains and five settings, covering holistic planning, feedback-conditioned step-wise planning, and robustness under extraneous tools, broken tools, and unsolvable tasks. Across 12 MLLMs, APB reveals systematic weaknesses in long-horizon planning, tool-noise robustness, calibrated refusal, and inference-time refinement. We further validate APB on 200 ToolSandbox tasks and 200 $\tau^2$-bench tasks, where APB-guided refinement consistently improves plan correctness, plan grade, and downstream execution metrics

translated_title: 智能体规划基准：面向大语言模型智能体规划能力的诊断框架
translated_abstract: 规划是大语言模型智能体的核心能力：在行动之前，智能体必须分解目标、选择工具、对约束条件进行推理，并判断任务何时不可行。然而，现有的智能体评估通常只报告端到端的成功与否，难以确定失败究竟源于规划还是执行。我们提出了智能体规划基准，这是一个专门针对规划能力的诊断性基准，包含跨22个领域、五种设置的4,209个多模态案例，涵盖整体规划、基于反馈的分步规划，以及在存在无关工具、损坏工具和不可解决任务情况下的鲁棒性测试。通过对12个多模态大语言模型的评估，APB揭示了模型在长程规划、工具噪声鲁棒性、校准的拒绝行为以及推理时改进方面存在系统性弱点。我们还在200个ToolSandbox任务和200个τ²-bench任务上进一步验证了APB，结果表明APB引导的改进能够持续提升规划正确性、规划等级以及下游执行指标。
tldr: APB是一个包含4,209个多模态案例的智能体规划专用诊断基准，能够定位大语言模型智能体在长程规划、工具噪声鲁棒性等方面的系统性弱点，且其引导的改进可持续提升规划质量与下游执行表现。
en_tdlr: APB is a planning-specific diagnostic benchmark with 4,209 multimodal cases that pinpoints systematic weaknesses in LLM agents' planning capabilities, and APB-guided refinement consistently improves plan correctness and downstream execution metrics.
